pitch_en: Converts vinasse and distillery effluents into BioDispersis, a natural dispersant reintegrated into industrial supply chains, achieving zero-waste production.
pitch_es: Convierte vinaza y efluentes de destilerías en BioDispersis, un dispersante natural reintegrado en cadenas de suministro industriales, logrando una producción de residuo cero.

sections.head_en: Vinasse and distillery effluents from industry are difficult to treat and often become waste rather than reusable inputs.
